thread:
sam: Heads-up — planning a soft-open for feature flag `cohort_unveil` tonight 22:00 UTC. Rollout plan: 10% immediate, wait 15m, bump to 35% for 30m, then hold. Region split: eu-west -> model v3.1, default -> v3.2. Pinning backend svc `realtime-api` to v3.2 for non-EU cohort.
deploy-bot: scheduled toggle job created by @sam for 2024-12-05T22:00:00Z. Steps recorded: preflight @21:30 -> step1 10% -> monitor 15m -> step2 35% -> soak 30m -> finalize. Use `/deploybot status 1737502468` for updates.
anya: Nice. Please add explicit rollback thresholds here so oncall can act quickly.
maria: Propose rollback rules: if error_rate delta (5m) > 1.0% absolute OR >2x baseline, whichever triggers first. Also rollback if p50 latency up >120ms or p95 up >250ms sustained for 5m.
leo: Add cost signal too — if token_cost per request increases >25% vs baseline for 10m, abort ramp and investigate.
ops-bot: Circuit-breaker policy attached: auto-drain cohort to 0% if error_rate >= 2% sustained for 2m. Manual rollback command:
```
/deploybot toggle cohort_unveil 0 --reason "manual rollback"
```
sam: I'll fold these into the deploy job metadata and the release notes. Also adding the runbook link.
anya: Runbook: https://redwood/ops/runbooks/cohort_unveil — make sure canary logs + debug-level hooks are enabled during first 30m.
maria: EU-specific note: we still see p95 regressions on v3.2 in eu-west from last week. Confirming region split is mandatory (eu-west -> v3.1). Sam, can routing be configured so EU cohort hits v3.1 while others hit v3.2?
sam: Yes — updating routing before flip. Will push config at 21:50 UTC.
leo: Who's on watch? Product & Support want a heads-up 30m before step1.
sam: I'll notify @product and @support at 21:30. Any volunteers to own first 60m oncall?
maria: I can monitor 22:00-23:00 UTC.
anya: I'll take 23:00-00:00 UTC.
sam: Great. Preflight run at 21:30. If green, I'll start job at 22:00. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: preflight checks complete (21:34 UTC). Smoke tests ok. Canary logs OK. Ready to execute.
sam: Starting soft-open now (22:00 UTC). Posting updates here. Ping if you see anything off.
maria: Early signal — minor p50 bump in eu-west, ~40ms. watching.
leo: Cost delta flat. No token amplification spikes so far.
anya: No errors, tracing looks healthy.
sam: Step1 applied: 10% cohort -> confirmed in `/deploybot status`. Monitoring 15m.
ops-bot: circuit-breaker status: OK. No auto-drain.
maria: After 12m, p95 in eu-west is still within threshold. Proceeding to step2 at +15m as planned.
sam: Bumping to 35% now. Noting in deploy-job meta.
leo: Noticing a small increase in average tokens per request in one downstream route; investigating with traces.
anya: Alerts: none triggered. All clear at 1st hour.
sam: Ramp to 35% successful. Holding for 30m soak.
maria: EU route on v3.1 remains stable. No rollback needed.
leo: Cost signal normalized after second minute. Looks nominal.
ops-bot: No automatic rollbacks fired. All metrics within configured thresholds.
anya: Good job. I'll draft a short blurb for release notes: "Soft-open: cohort_unveil enabled for controlled cohort testing; regional pinning applied for eu-west."
sam: Adding release-notes entry and linking this thread. Final summary + postmortem template (if any issues): note timeline, thresholds hit, affected users, remediation steps.
maria: I'll keep an eye for another 30m then hand off to oncall rotation.
sam: Thanks all. Closing live-monitoring, leaving thread open for any follow-ups. :rocket:
